name: Steamed scad
summary: Steamed scad, firm and sweet, fragrant with fried onion. Wrap it in bánh tráng with herbs and dip it in a sour-hot sauce or mắm nêm.
origin: Phu Yen. Du lịch Phú Yên’s 6 October 2024 cẩm nang is the account of cá nục hấp.
texture: The flesh is firm and sweet, with the smell of fried onion and the seasonings.
howToEat: Wrap the fish in bánh tráng with herbs, then dip it in a sour-hot sauce or mắm nêm.
seoTitle: Steamed scad in Phu Yen — with rice paper and herbs
seoDescription: Steamed scad with fried onion, wrapped in rice paper with herbs and dipped in a sour-hot sauce or mam nem.
